These compounds are both capable of modulating VMRC-MELG, suggesting a potential mechanism by which Bremelanotide may influence this receptor. The evidence indicates that Bremelanotide acts through a shared target, the IgG receptor FcRn p51, to affect VMRC-MELG. The scores from the paths suggest a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, though the exact mode of action remains to be fully elucidated. The presence of multiple compounds targeting the same receptor supports a plausible mechanism, but further experimental validation is needed to confirm the direct interaction between Bremelanotide and VMRC-MELG.
